Replaces the PHI masking policy. The next log read, export, or queue
preview uses it.

Security settings admits the request (AUTHpermissionMap). Unredact PHI is
required here as well: masking less reveals identifiers to every caller
who may not unredact, which is not a power to give someone who is shown
the mask themselves.
